name: The Mark of Beauty
description: Show discusses a variety of everyday art and craft items from Japan. Each episode covers a single item in depth to explain the hidden beauty in the items history and making.

videos.title: 「春呼ぶ、ランドセル」
videos.overview:
Recently, the number of school bags that adults can use is increasing.

This is an antique leather school bag.

It even comes with a hook for a school lunch bag and a name card holder.
